overview.title: The classic lake outing from Ifrane
overview.p1: Dayet Aoua is one of the best-known lakes near Ifrane. The shoreline invites easy walks, birdwatching, and hillside views. Water levels fluctuate by season.
overview.p2: Bring water and a windproof layer. Driving or joining an organized transfer is the usual way to get here from town.

food.title: Eating near Dayet Aoua
food.p1: Facilities at the lake are limited. Plan a picnic or have a meal in Ifrane before or after.
food.p2: Do not rely on lakeside restaurants — bring what you need and pack out your trash.
food.li5: Leave no trash by the lake.

1.desc: Short drive from Ifrane; check road conditions after rain or snow.

2.title: Wildlife
2.desc: Watch birds quietly; do not feed the animals.

3.title: Footwear
3.desc: Paths can get muddy — wear closed-toe shoes.

q1.question: How far is it from Ifrane?
q1.answer: A short drive — typically under 30 minutes depending on the route.

q2.question: Can you swim here?
q2.answer: It is more of a nature stop than a swimming beach; respect local rules and water conditions.

q3.question: When is the best season?
q3.answer: Spring and autumn for mild weather; summer is popular for the cool mountain air.

q4.question: Do I need a guide?
q4.answer: No, not for a simple shoreline walk.

q5.question: Can I combine it with the cedar forest?
q5.answer: Yes — it makes a classic nature day out around Ifrane.
